usage: 意大利 is used to refer to the country Italy in conversation.
It functions as a proper noun when naming the country.
You can use 意大利 as a subject or object in a sentence.
意大利 can appear with location verbs like 去 (go) or 係 (be at).
It often appears in travel, food, or cultural contexts.
